name: Alignment Format Converter
description: Convert sequence alignments and character matrices between FASTA, NEXUS, PHYLIP, NeXML, Clustal, and Stockholm. Any supported format can be read or written. Morphology/standard data is fully represented in NEXUS/NeXML.

fields.label: Input file
fields.help: Input alignment (FASTA, NEXUS, PHYLIP, NeXML, Clustal, or Stockholm).

fields.label: Output file
fields.help: Destination path for the converted alignment.

fields.label: Input format
fields.help: Input format. Auto-detect by file extension is recommended; specify only when detection is ambiguous.

fields.label: Data type
fields.help: Data type for schema-less inputs (FASTA/PHYLIP/Clustal/Stockholm) and for NEXUS/NeXML output. NEXUS/NeXML inputs are auto-detected. Use 'standard' for morphological matrices.

fields.label: Relaxed PHYLIP
fields.help: Write relaxed PHYLIP with long taxon names (accepted by IQ-TREE). Applies to PHYLIP output only.
